values.note: Two loops. The upper loop is mostly level with several larger sites; the lower loop, near the river, has 2 larger sites, a few short pull-throughs and several tent spots. Vehicles must fit the spur; no overflow parking.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/transfer-park-campground ('Two loops have 25 sites with shade and sun, and large, open play areas. The upper loop is mostly level, with several larger sites. The lower loop is near the river and has 2 larger sites, a few short pull-throughs, and several tent spots.'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available.'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water in the main season only; none during the fall extension.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/transfer-park-campground ('Vault Toilet (3)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; Current Conditions 'No water available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165701 (notice 'Water is available at this campground during the open season.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late May through September; in 2026 open with limited services and no water from the end of September to November 15.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/transfer-park-campground ('Seasons of Use: Late May through September.'; Current Conditions 'Campground open from end of September through November 15th, 2026 with limited services. No water available.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First come, first served only; claim a site in person and pay on site (recreation.gov Scan & Pay).

note: Former mining-era ore transfer station on 11 acres above the Florida River, ~1 mi past Florida Campground at ~8,500 ft: from Durango ~13 mi on Florida Road (CR 240), then CR 243 / FR 596 ~8.5 mi, passing through Florida Campground. Burnt Timber Trail parking (Weminuche Wilderness) is near the campground. --Claude
